study: Blinded eBOSS DR16 ELG full_ALLdata FITS header-only candidate triage
published_catalogue_description: SDSS DR16 LSS documentation: full_ALLdata contains targets remaining after masks are applied; not a pre-veto production reference
method: HTTP 206 exact FITS 2880-byte Range requests for primary and first BINTABLE header only; stop at each END card, never request table-data offsets. Require zero-length primary HDU to reach next header without seeking through data. Record header and range SHA256 separately from complete file identity; no full file checksum claimed.
abort_on: HTTP 200 or missing/malformed Content-Range for any block
redirect outside exact pinned official release root
independent_production_reference_gate: Header field presence alone cannot establish bit8 production mask. Require authenticated pre-veto bit-coded full output or production bitmap with SHA256 and positive/negative positions. Never infer pipeline convention from post-veto survivors.
